records.jp: 思い出が、流れ込んでくる……
records.en_original: My memories are flowing back...
records.en_auxiliary: My memories are flowing back...
records.en: My memories are flowing back...

records.jp: お姉ちゃん！
records.en_original: Mio!
records.en_auxiliary: Mio!
records.en: Onee-chan!

records.jp: ええ、思い出した
records.en_original: Yes... I remember.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes... I remember.
records.en: Yes... I remember.

records.jp: 私たちは……やっぱり諦めきれなくて。<CR>もう一度、お母さんのところに行ったんだ
records.en_original: We couldn't give up on our mom. We went to see her again.
records.en_auxiliary: We couldn't give up on our mom. We went to see her again.
records.en: We... still could not give up.<CR>So we went to see Mom one more time.

records.jp: なんで会いたくないのか……<CR>その理由を聞かないと、納得なんてできなかったから
records.en_original: We needed to know why she didn't want to see us.
records.en_auxiliary: We needed to know why she didn't want to see us.
records.en: We could not accept it<CR>without asking why she did not want to see us.

records.jp: だから、直接会って、聞いた。<CR>そして、私たちは……お母さんの本当の想いを知った
records.en_original: And so we met with her. And we heard it in her own words...
records.en_auxiliary: And so we met with her. And we heard it in her own words...
records.en: So we met her and asked her directly.<CR>And then... we learned how Mom truly felt.

records.jp: 私なんかが母親なせいで、<CR>二人に悲しい思いばかりさせて……
records.en_original: I put you two through so much pain...
records.en_auxiliary: I put you two through so much pain...
records.en: Because someone like me was your mother,<CR>I did nothing but make both of you sad...

records.jp: 団地でも肩身の狭い思いをさせてしまって……
records.en_original: You must have felt so ashamed of me.
records.en_auxiliary: You must have felt so ashamed of me.
records.en: I made you feel so unwelcome in the housing complex...

records.jp: 二人のために何もしてやれない自分が、情けなくて……
records.en_original: I couldn't stand how little I was able to do for you...
records.en_auxiliary: I couldn't stand how little I was able to do for you...
records.en: I was ashamed of myself for being unable to do anything for you...

records.jp: これ以上あなたたちを<CR>不幸にさせるわけにはいかないって、思った
records.en_original: I didn't want to hurt you anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't want to hurt you anymore.
records.en: I thought I could not allow myself<CR>to make you any more unhappy.

records.jp: 私がいても、あなたたちを不幸にする！<CR>だから、もう関わらないで！
records.en_original: You'll find nothing but sadness with me. So please, forget about me!
records.en_auxiliary: You'll find nothing but sadness with me. So please, forget about me!
records.en: All I do is make you unhappy!<CR>So please, stay away from me!

records.jp: あなたたちは……あなたたちの人生を歩んで……っ
records.en_original: You have to live your own lives... Without me.
records.en_auxiliary: You have to live your own lives... Without me.
records.en: You two... should live your own lives...

records.jp: お母さん……
records.en_original: Mom...
records.en_auxiliary: Mom...
records.en: Mom...

records.jp: 私たちは……お母さんの気持ちに気づけなかった
records.en_original: We never realized how our mother felt.
records.en_auxiliary: We never realized how our mother felt.
records.en: We... had never noticed how Mom felt.

records.jp: お母さんも、私たちの気持ちに気づいてくれなかった
records.en_original: And she never realized how we felt.
records.en_auxiliary: And she never realized how we felt.
records.en: And Mom had never noticed how we felt.

records.jp: ……いつか、私とお姉ちゃんで誕生日ケーキを<CR>作ったことがあったんだ
records.en_original: There was this one time, Mio and I made a birthday cake for Mom.
records.en_auxiliary: There was this one time, Mio and I made a birthday cake for Mom.
records.en: ...One year, Onee-chan and I<CR>made her a birthday cake.

records.jp: その時、お母さんは私たちに謝ったの
records.en_original: When she saw it, she apologized to us.
records.en_auxiliary: When she saw it, she apologized to us.
records.en: That was when Mom apologized to us.

records.jp: 心配をかけてごめん
records.en_original: "I'm sorry for worrying you," she said.
records.en_auxiliary: "I'm sorry for worrying you," she said.
records.en: "I'm sorry for making you worry."

records.jp: ダメなお母さんでごめん、って
records.en_original: "I'm a terrible mother."
records.en_auxiliary: "I'm a terrible mother."
records.en: "I'm sorry I'm such a terrible mother," she said.

records.jp: でも、違ったんだ。<CR>私たちが欲しかったのは「ごめんなさい」じゃない
records.en_original: But she was wrong. We didn't want her to apologize to us.
records.en_auxiliary: But she was wrong. We didn't want her to apologize to us.
records.en: But that was not what we wanted.<CR>We did not want her to say, "I'm sorry."

records.jp: ありがとうって、そう言ってくれるだけでよかった
records.en_original: We just wanted her to be happy.
records.en_auxiliary: We just wanted her to be happy.
records.en: All we wanted was for her to say, "Thank you."

records.jp: お母さんが作ってくれたカレーを食べて、<CR>一緒にいられるだけで、私たちは幸せだったから……
records.en_original: We were happy as long as we were together, eating our mom's curry.
records.en_auxiliary: We were happy as long as we were together, eating our mom's curry.
records.en: We were happy just eating the curry Mom made<CR>and being together...

records.jp: だからお母さんも、負い目なんて感じないで。<CR>お母さんが辛いときは、私たちが支えるから……って
records.en_original: We wanted to tell her not to be so hard on herself. To tell her that whenever she would go through bad times, we'd be there to support her.
records.en_auxiliary: We wanted to tell her not to be so hard on herself. To tell her that whenever she would go through bad times, we'd be there to support her.
records.en: So we told Mom not to feel indebted.<CR>That when things were hard, we would support her...

records.jp: 私たちは、ようやくお母さんに<CR>想いを伝えることができた……――
records.en_original: We wanted to finally tell her how we really felt...
records.en_auxiliary: We wanted to finally tell her how we really felt...
records.en: At last, we were able to tell Mom<CR>how we truly felt...—

records.jp: フラグメントの再接続を確認しました。<CR>世界構築の安定性低下に注意してください
records.en_original: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en_auxiliary: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en: Fragment reconnection confirmed.<CR>Caution: stability of world construction decreasing.

records.jp: わっ、これ――
records.en_original: Ah! That's—
records.en_auxiliary: Ah! That's—
records.en: Ah! That's—

records.jp: フラグメント。二人の想いの結晶だよ
records.en_original: Fragments. A shard of your emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: Fragments. A shard of your emotions.
records.en: A Fragment. The crystallization of your feelings.

records.jp: さあ、手を伸ばすのです
records.en_original: Here, you reach out your hand.
records.en_auxiliary: Here, you reach out your hand.
records.en: Now, reach out your hands.

records.jp: 陽桜莉、美弦。ごめ――
records.en_original: Hiori. Mio. I'm so sor—
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori. Mio. I'm so sor—
records.en: Hiori. Mio. I'm so sor—

records.jp: お母さん？
records.en_original: Mom?
records.en_auxiliary: Mom?
records.en: Mom?

records.jp: もう、それは無しにしよう？
records.en_original: No more apologizing... Okay?
records.en_auxiliary: No more apologizing... Okay?
records.en: No more of that, okay?

records.jp: ……そうね。そうだった。私の悪い癖だ――
records.en_original: Yes... You're right. A terrible habit of mine.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes... You're right. A terrible habit of mine.
records.en: ...Yes. That's right. It is a bad habit of mine—

records.jp: ……ありがとう。<CR>こんな母親を、いつまでも愛してくれて……ありがとう
records.en_original: Thank you... I love you both so much.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you... I love you both so much.
records.en: ...Thank you.<CR>Thank you for continuing to love a mother like me...

records.jp: 私たちのやってきたことは、間違ってなかったのかな
records.en_original: We did the right thing, didn't we?
records.en_auxiliary: We did the right thing, didn't we?
records.en: I wonder if what we did was right.

records.jp: うん、きっとそう
records.en_original: I know that we did.
records.en_auxiliary: I know that we did.
records.en: Yeah. I'm sure it was.

records.jp: ちゃんとお話して、向き合って――
records.en_original: As long as you take the time to talk together with someone...
records.en_auxiliary: As long as you take the time to talk together with someone...
records.en: We talked everything through and faced each other—

records.jp: 答えを出せば、きっと分かり合える
records.en_original: You can come to understand each other.
records.en_auxiliary: You can come to understand each other.
records.en: And by finding an answer, we were finally able to understand one another.

records.jp: みんなー！！　ありがとーーー！！
records.en_original: Thank you for all your help, everyone!
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you for all your help, everyone!
records.en: Everyone!! Thank you so much!!

records.jp: じゃ、帰ろっか
records.en_original: Let's head back.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's head back.
records.en: All right, let's go home.
